description: Revert to the aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) configuration which historically yielded the best convergence speed (val_bpb ~0.983), as the previous run with LR 0.08 (val_bpb 0.9800) likely under-utilized the 5-minute budget by converging too slowly, while maintaining the stable Depth 10 / Batch 128 configuration that avoids OOM crashes.
